title: Pogali
description: Indo-Aryan language of the Jammu region
extract: Pogali, or Poguli is a language spoken in Jammu and Kashmir, primarily in Ramban and Chenani. It falls under the larger umbrella of Indo-Aryan languages. The language has a rich history and is characterized by its unique vocabulary and grammar, which is influenced by Western Pahari languages and kashmiri language, with additional influences from Persian, Rajasthani, and Sanskrit. Pogali serves as a common means of communication among both Hindu and Muslim communities in the region. Despite the linguistic variations across different areas, Pogali has remained an essential part of the local culture.
